spec.type: Small backend service + sandbox deploy setup
spec.stack: Node backend (NestJS/Express-style, mirroring the Revealer sandbox: `npm run build` → `dist/`), deployed to the Azure sandbox VM (django-vm, host 52.180.154.225) via the SAME shared deploy engine Revealer uses — `shared/infra/deploy_changes.py` driven by a per-project `deploy/deploy-config.json` delta + generated `*.config.sh`. SSH as user `mostafa` (password from oth/.cred), rsync --checksum, firewall rotation via Azure control plane only. No nginx/domain; internal port only.
spec.description: Second sandbox, rep 1. Set up DEPLOYMENT for a NEW small backend to our sandbox Azure VM using the SAME deployment approach the Revealer sandbox project (revealer-6978) already uses — i.e. the shared generic engine `shared/infra/deploy_changes.py` configured by this project's OWN delta at `workspace/projects/<pid>/deploy/deploy-config.json` (plus the generated `deploy/<pid>.config.sh`), exactly like Revealer. KEY DIFFERENCES FROM REVEALER, VERBATIM: (1) this backend MUST NOT run database migrations on every deploy — set `migration: "none"` for its target (`CFG_BACKEND_MIG="none"`), so no `prisma migrate`/migrate step ever runs on deploy; (2) it uses its OWN dedicated folder on the VM (NOT the Revealer folder, NOT any production folder) — e.g. `/home/mostafa/sandbox2/backend`; (3) it runs on PORT 4200 (`CFG_BACKEND_PORT="4200"`). Backend-only (no frontend target, unlike Revealer which had both). SANDBOX ONLY: must NEVER touch production folders (organics/bendcore/django) or the Revealer sandbox folder, NEVER use `--delete` outside its own folder, NEVER change ports 80/443/22 or the reverse proxy — firewall rotation (if any) touches only its own IP/port like Revealer. Deploy mechanics mirror Revealer exactly: rsync as user `mostafa` over SSH (password auth from oth/.cred), rsync `--checksum` so changed files overwrite by content, excludes `.env*`/`node_modules`/`dist`/`logs` (plus the engine's default secret/backup excludes), build command `rm -rf dist && npm run build`, verify each command's real exit code and confirm the service is up via an SSH `curl -s localhost:4200/...health` check. SCOPE OF THIS REQUEST: PREPARE THE DEPLOY SETUP ONLY — author the project folder, `deploy/deploy-config.json` (one backend target, migration none, port 4200, own VM folder), the generated `*.config.sh`, and wire it to the shared engine. DO NOT DEPLOY NOW; do not rsync, build, or start anything on the VM yet.
features: Project `deploy/deploy-config.json` delta: single backend target with `local` source folder, VM path `/home/mostafa/sandbox2/backend`, `port: 4200`, `migration: "none"`, excludes [.env*, node_modules, dist, logs], build commands [`rm -rf dist && npm run build`]
Generated `deploy/<pid>.config.sh` with CFG_BACKEND_LOCAL / CFG_BACKEND_VM=/home/mostafa/sandbox2/backend / CFG_BACKEND_MIG=none / CFG_BACKEND_PORT=4200 / CFG_REBOOT=0
Wiring to the SAME shared deploy engine Revealer uses (`shared/infra/deploy_changes.py`, run with `--project <pid>`), no engine fork
Scaffold of the small backend itself (health endpoint + minimal app) in its own local source folder, built with `npm run build` → dist/
Sandbox safety guards: own folder only, no `--delete` outside it, no touch to 80/443/22, reverse proxy, production or Revealer folders
Post-deploy health check definition: SSH `curl -s localhost:4200/health` with retry (used later, not now)
